author: CC
prose: The bus's stop record (stops.jsonl, written from cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/server.py:753) carries caller_pid and caller_cmd only, never the caller's class root. On 2026-11-20 four op-shutdown stops (02:13:05Z-02:39:13Z) read alike whether the caller was the house root replacing a bus made stale by main moving (allowed, 3deafc9e36de outcome 2) or a foreign checkout (the red that ticket's watch looks for); telling them apart took commit timing, and the caller pids were already gone.
